source_text: Non es facta ut meretrix congregans mercedes; tu dedisti mercedes omnibus amatoribus. Gloria Deo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: You were not made like a harlot gathering wages; you gave wages to all lovers. Glory to God. Amen.
pass_b_english: Unlike a hireling harlot, Jerusalem [[pays her lovers >> Bible:Ezekiel 16:33-34]] — pouring gifts on idols. Glory to God. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
